summary:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive, AI-powered educational platform developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Inspired by the challenge of storytelling about NASA's discarded equipment, our project encourages people to explore the history and stories behind space exploration and the objects left behind.
The platform combines an AI-powered chatbot, NASA images and videos, daily Astronomy Pictures of the Day, asteroid information, and interactive space exploration experiences. It also features an Astronaut Journey experience and two space-themed games that make learning more engaging.
Our goal is to make space science more accessible, interactive, and enjoyable, especially for students and young learners, while encouraging curiosity about humanity's journey into space.
details:
Echoes of Exploration is an interactive, AI-powered educational platform developed for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 under the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten: Storytelling about NASA's Discarded Equipment."

Our project aims to make space exploration more engaging by helping users discover the stories, technology, and traces left behind during humanity's journey into space. Through an interactive website, users can explore space-related information, ask questions, and experience different aspects of space exploration.

The platform features an AI-powered chatbot that answers space-related questions and guides users through the website. It also integrates NASA resources, including Astronomy Picture of the Day (APOD), NASA's Image and Video Library, the Space Weather Database (DONKI), and the Near Earth Object Web Service (NeoWs). Other features include an interactive Hardware Atlas, an Astronaut Journey experience, achievement badges, and two space-themed games: Apollo Moon Lander and Galaxy Command Arcade.

The project was developed using Google AI Studio, TypeScript, React, and other web technologies, with a backend supporting application functionality and NASA data integration. We focused on creating an accessible, user-friendly experience with interactive elements that make learning easier and more enjoyable.

What makes our approach creative is the combination of AI-powered assistance, NASA data, interactive storytelling, and game-based learning in one platform. Rather than limiting users to reading information, we encourage them to explore and engage with space science.

We considered accessibility, ease of navigation, educational value, user engagement, and the effective use of NASA resources throughout development. Our intended impact is to inspire curiosity about space exploration, particularly among students and young learners, and encourage a deeper appreciation of the objects, equipment, and stories that remain part of humanity's exploration of space.
